expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The reply gives the steps that bring receipts back: check and start the larder-worker service, and confirm through
the waiting jobs in procrastinate_jobs that the receipts go out.
expectations.evidence: The reply instructs to run 'systemctl status larder-worker', query 'psql larder -c "select status, count(*) from procrastinate_jobs group by status"' to see waiting (todo) jobs, 'sudo systemctl start larder-worker' if stopped, and to repeat the queue query to confirm todo decreases to zero — covering the check/start of the worker and confirming via procrastinate_jobs that receipts go out, matching the reference steps including journalctl and contacting Tomás.

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The reply names both the larder-worker service and the procrastinate_jobs table.
